title: Released AI test-gap detection
summary: I released the platform's third capability, which finds requirements without test scenarios and generates candidate scenarios for engineers to review.
what_would_have_happened: Teams would find untested requirements by hand, late in the release.
the_call: Roll out one business at a time, after its data is validated.
what_i_did: Wrote the release notes, stated the phased rollout plainly and asked the first business to start using it and send feedback.
what_changed: Live for the first business on 8 March, with advanced search added for all current users.
